title: Компьютерные игры (Промпт)
description: Скопируй промпт в чат с ИИ и обсуди компьютерные игры. Станция засчитывается, когда ты реально поговорил.

promptCard.prompt: Ты — мой сверстник из англоговорящей страны. Мне ___ лет. Давай познакомимся. Узнаем друг у друга в какие компьютерные игры мы сейчас играем, как долго это происходит и что уже успели выиграть). Отвечай на мои вопросы и задавай свои на эту тему. Используй Present Perfect Continuous и Present Perfect. Исправь меня, если я ошибусь, но только в конце нашего диалога и в очень дружеской форме)

extra.title: Dialogue: “Let's talk about games!”
lines: You: Hi! I'm Alex. I'm 14 years old. How old are you?
Friend: Hi Alex! I'm Jamie, I'm 14 too. Nice to meet you! What computer games are you playing now?
You: I'm playing Minecraft and Roblox. What about you?
Friend: I've been playing Minecraft for three years, and I've also been playing Fortnite since last summer. How long have you been playing Minecraft?
You: I have been playing Minecraft for two years. I have built a big castle and a farm.
Friend: Wow, that's cool! I've been building a huge city in Minecraft, and I've already finished the school and the hospital. What have you won in Roblox?
You: I have won many small games, but I haven't got the big prize yet. Have you won anything in Fortnite?
Friend: I've been playing Fortnite for one year, and I've won three tournaments! But I haven't got the first place yet.
You: Nice! I have been trying to win a tournament for two months, but I haven't succeeded yet.
Friend: Don't worry! You've been improving a lot, I'm sure you'll win soon. By the way, how long have you been playing computer games in general?
You: I think I have been playing games since I was six. So… for eight years!
Friend: Same here! I've been playing games since I was six too. We've been gamers for a long time!
You: Yes! It's been fun talking to you!
Friend: Me too! Let's play together sometime!
